style_template: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual finished cocktail illustration for a 2D western saloon game's parchment recipe journal and menu. Primary request: draw exactly ONE physically plausible {cocktail_name}, with {glass_shape}, {liquid_description}, {ice_description}, and {garnish_description}. Style/medium: refined hand-painted gouache and watercolor game item illustration, semi-realistic proportions, subtle natural paper-like brush texture INSIDE the painted object only, delicate warm dark-brown contour accents, restrained amber highlights, believable transparent glass, clearly readable silhouette. Composition: square canvas, full glass and entire stem/base and garnish visible, centered with generous clean 12 percent margins, slight elevated three-quarter front view that shows the rim ellipse and drink surface. Lighting: soft warm saloon light from upper left, subtle cool glass reflections, preserve the drink's true color. Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha outside the object and through unpainted glass areas; no backdrop, no paper card, no tabletop, no cast floor shadow. Constraints: accurate finished serving presentation, no ingredients placed outside glass, no bottles, no bartending tools, no humans, no hats, no frame, no lettering, no labels, no logo, no watermark; no pixel art, no shiny 3D render, no comic face, no exaggerated fantasy shapes. Output: a crisp square transparent PNG suitable for small in-game catalogue cards.
